en: Sepia-toned panoramic view over a small European town surrounded by gently rolling hills and fields. Dense clusters of pitched-roof houses fill the foreground, with several factory chimneys visible. Dominating the town center is a large church with a tall steeple and clock tower. Conifer trees frame the lower edge of the image. At the top left, printed text reads "Roßwein i. Sa.", indicating the town name and region.
